admission_requirements.general_requirements: Jordanian General Secondary Certificate (Tawjihi) or equivalent. Minimum 60% for general admission; Engineering and Pharmacy require 80%+, Allied Medical Sciences 75%+, Nursing and Law 70%+.
admission_requirements.exam_details: No general entrance exam required; placement tests may be required for language or computer proficiency.
admission_requirements.english_requirement: TOEFL or IELTS required for master's program admission; no specific English proficiency requirement specified for undergraduate admission.

tuition_fees.notes: Tuition varies by program and is charged per credit hour. Fees listed are for Jordanian students. International students pay in USD at higher rates (range approximately 140-230 USD per credit hour). Scholarships and installment plans available.

ranking_accreditation.national_ranking: Ranked #1 among Jordanian private universities; #401-500 in THE World University Rankings 2026 (first among all Jordanian universities)
ranking_accreditation.accreditation: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (MOHE), ABET (Engineering & IT programs), ACPE (Pharmacy), ASIC (Platinum Award), AACSB (Business School), IIMP (Marketing)
ranking_accreditation.international_recognition: QS World University Rankings #761-770 (2026); THE World University Rankings #401-500 (2026); QS Arab Region #32; THE Arab University Ranking #28; QS Stars Five Stars rating

market_demand.notes: Employment rate based on 2023/2024 graduate survey (2,001 respondents, 95% response rate). University operates Career Guidance and Alumni Office, holds annual Career Day (90+ companies in 2025), and partners with companies like Zoho for graduate recruitment.

campus_facilities.accommodation_details: On-campus female dormitories (Al-Zahra'a, Al-Khansa'a/Shajarat Al-Dorr, Al-Batool, Apartment System) with modern furniture, wireless internet, free sports complex access, transportation services including shopping trips and airport transfers, medical care, and 24-hour supervision.
campus_facilities.scholarship_details: Various scholarship programs available including external scholarships (e.g., Brazilian Embassy scholarships), financial aid, and installment-based fee structures for financially constrained students.

contact_info.address: Al Salt Road, Sweileh, Amman, Jordan
